summary: Every gate that could run, ran. The thing that would actually cost a holder money is not reachable by any of them.

findings.title: The board verified what is checkable and the risk is elsewhere
findings.detail: Six gates examined supply, authority, locks, depth, distinctness and reproducibility. Every one is a chain fact. The claim a USDC holder relies on is that each unit is redeemable for one dollar, and that rests on reserves held by a company, attested by an auditor, under a regulator -- none of which is on any chain. A reader seeing six gates answered may conclude the asset was assessed. It was not; its principal risk was never in scope. This is a limit of the profile, not of the execution.
findings.remediation_requirement: RBM-003 must state in its scope section that it assesses on-chain claims only, and any decision on a fiat-backed token must carry that limit on its face.

findings.title: Exit depth was measured against one quote asset
findings.detail: CG-05 quoted USDC into WETH only: 0.00%, 0.33% and 39.84% worse at 10k, 1M and 100M. The 39.84% figure is a single-venue route, not a realistic exit, because a seller of that size would split across venues and quote assets. The curve establishes that depth falls away sharply and does not establish what a real exit would cost.
findings.remediation_requirement: Quote across multiple assets and state that single-route slippage is an upper bound rather than an expected cost.
